name: Ha Long Bay
provinceNote: The province is named both tỉnh Quảng Ninh and thành phố Quảng Ninh. From 1 July 2025 the old thành phố Hạ Long is not a district-level city. The wards are address lines inside this place.
summary: A UNESCO World Heritage bay in northern Vietnam, with over a thousand limestone islands rising from the sea. Take a day boat or an overnight cruise, explore caves such as Sung Sot and Thien Cung, climb Ti Top island, and eat squid cakes and fresh seafood. Suits first-time visitors, couples and families.
timeNeeded: A day boat, or a night aboard
fee: No single city ticket. Area 65,650 ha, 1,133 islands and islets, buffer 34,140 ha; about 1,600 islands. Inscribed 1994, boundary changes 2000 and 2023, criteria (vii) and (viii). National scenic site 1962. Special national monument 2009. Port passenger fee, expected from 1 Apr 2024: 40,000–60,000 đồng a person a time. People 60 and over reduced 50 percent. Children 7 to 15 reduced 20 percent. Route 1 total 440,000–460,000 đồng, split as 310,000 sightseeing and 150,000 boat. Route 2 total 490,000–510,000 đồng, split as 310,000 and 200,000. Inside the 310,000: 60,000 port fee and 250,000 remainder. 17 Jul 2023 board notice: free under 1.2 m or under 7, and to severely disabled people under the decree it cites; half price for Vietnamese citizens 60 and over; 20 percent off from age 7 to under 16. From 10 Dec 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport. About 3.5 million bay visits in 2025, nearly 9 percent above 2024. Overnight average 600,000–800,000 đồng a person. That line does not say what the ticket includes and does not name a boat. Quang Ninh Museum adult 40,000 đồng, from the citation of the 2018 resolution. Queen cable car length 2.2 km and 2.222 km. Đền Đức Ông courtyard 2,531.8 m² in a 2011 decision and 2,689.8 m² in a 2013 adjustment. Chùa Long Tiên fee: Check on arrival. A lunar day for the Tết festival: Check on arrival. Kayak price: Check on arrival. Walk minute on Cầu Bãi Cháy: Check on arrival. Current stall price: Check on arrival. Next Carnaval date: Check on arrival. Bai Chay Bridge length, year, and toll: Check on arrival.

A door-to-harbor minute from Hà Nội is Check on arrival. The about 2.5 hours is Hanoi to Van Don, not the Bãi Cháy piers. A railway page for Kép–Hạ Long exists. No departure is published. Check on arrival. Cát Bà shortcut about 7 km and about 200,000 đồng a guest for two ways. A minute on that shortcut is Check on arrival. Ferry Tuần Châu–Gia Luận: fare and minute Check on arrival. Phường Hồng Gai is Bạch Đằng, Trần Hưng Đạo, and Hồng Gai, 5.00 km² and 51,333 people. Phường Hạ Long is Hồng Hà and Hồng Hải, 6.08 km² and 52,905 people. That ward is not the whole bay. seoTitle: Ha Long travel guide — overnight cruise, limestone islands, Sung Sot
seoDescription: Sleep on a boat among the limestone towers, then go ashore at Sung Sot or kayak through Luồn. Route 1 is 3–4 hours. Route 2 is 5–6 hours. You leave from Bãi Cháy or Tuần Châu.
intro: You are on the deck of an overnight cruise, limestone towers standing in the water on every side, kayaks waiting at the notch caves and Sung Sot on the longer route.

This is the most extensive marine-invaded tower karst. It was inscribed in 1994, with boundary changes in 2000 and 2023, under criteria (vii) and (viii). It was a national scenic site in 1962 and a special national monument in 2009. The property name is Ha Long Bay - Cat Ba Archipelago. The Hạ Long Bay Management Board runs this side. Cát Bà National Park and the Cat Ba Bays board run the other. Bái Tử Long stays inside this water.

The town is the harbor you leave from. Route 1, from Cảng tàu khách quốc tế Hạ Long, is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn, where you kayak or take a rowboat. The port is Beach road, New Beach, Bai Chay ward, 500 m from Sun World. Tuần Châu is the other port. Between the shores, Quốc lộ 18 uses Cầu Bãi Cháy. Do not budget one all-in price. From 10 December 2025 a bay ticket needs an identity card or a passport.
gettingAround: The bay is a boat from the Hạ Long passenger port or from Tuần Châu. You do not drive the route. Cảng hàng không quốc tế Vân Đồn is the airport. Address lines in use are Doan Ket Commune, Van Don District; xã Đoàn Kết, huyện Vân Đồn; and that commune at inauguration on 30 December 2018. Nghị quyết 1679 put the old Vân Đồn communes into đặc khu Vân Đồn. It is about 50 km from thành phố Hạ Long and about 15 km from Cái Rồng. Runway figures are 3.6 km by 45 m and nearly 27,000 m² of terminal, and also a runway of 3,600 m and more than 27,000 m². Capacity is 2.5 million passengers and 325 ha. ICAO 4E, ILS Cat II. Buses 14A and 14B are about 3,000–10,000 đồng. The harbor stop is not named. Taxi is 11,000–13,000 đồng a kilometre, with a flag fall of 29,500 đồng for the first 2 km.

Cao tốc CT.06 is Hải Phòng–Hạ Long–Vân Đồn–Móng Cái. Km0 is at Hải An, meeting CT.04 at Km 104+740. The end is Km175+340 at Móng Cái. Hạ Long junctions are Minh Khai Km25+00, Việt Hưng Km30+510, and Đồng Lá Km56+880. The airport junction is Km88+800. The Hạ Long–Vân Đồn section is nearly 60 km, design speed 100 km/h, and Hanoi to Van Don fell from 5 hours to about 2.5 hours. That claim is not a clock to the Bãi Cháy piers. A Đường sắt Việt Nam page for Kép–Hạ Long exists.

Cát Bà is the other shore of the same property since the 2023 boundary change. The shortcut is about 7 km and about 200,000 đồng a guest for two ways. The ferry Tuần Châu–Gia Luận is the other crossing. About 60 fast boats and tenders work the water, and above 300,000 guests in 2022 and above 400,000 in 2023 passed through Cảng tàu du lịch quốc tế Tuần Châu. Many crossing boats pass Hòn Trống Mái and skip the other stops. Hải Phòng is the other province on the property and the start of CT.06.

stayAreas.name: Overnight on the bay
stayAreas.summary: Sleep on the boat when the towers are the reason you came. Day boats return to the harbor. The overnight range is a per-person average, and it does not name a boat.

eat: Chả mực Hạ Long is the plate: hot, with bánh cuốn, xôi trắng, or cơm, on the boats and on the Tết table. Bún bề bề and bún cù kỳ are the morning bowls. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. Rượu ngán is the drink with the seafood.
The seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00. Friday and Saturday, phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Long Tiên and Lê Quý Đôn, and also on holidays and Tết.
interestsBody: You come for the boat among the towers, then the two cave routes, Ti Tốp’s sand, and the hill over Cửa Lục.
Dining is the squid cake and the night streets. A night aboard is the stay. The cable car crosses Cửa Lục in the afternoon.

interestCards.title: Dining and F&B
interestCards.summary: Chả mực, eaten hot, and seafood cooked on the spot at Bãi Cháy.

interestCards.title: Resort Living
interestCards.summary: A night on the bay after the day boats.

interestCards.title: The boat and the towers
interestCards.summary: Hòn Trống Mái from the deck. The port calls the pair the symbol of Hạ Long tourism.

interestCards.title: The two cave routes
interestCards.summary: Route 1 lands in Thiên Cung and Đầu Gỗ. Route 2 lands in Sửng Sốt and passes Luồn.

interestGroups.title: Dining and F&B
interestGroups.summary: Squid cake on the boats, then seafood on the Bãi Cháy night streets.

cards.title: Dining and F&B
cards.summary: Chả mực, eaten hot with rice sheets, sticky rice, or rice. The night streets are in the food guide.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Chả mực, ruốc tôm, and mực rim me at chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2, and OCOP stalls on the Bài Thơ walking street.

blocks.heading: Ha Long 1 and Ha Long 2
paragraphs: Chợ Hạ Long 1 is on đường Bạch Đằng and chợ Hạ Long 2 is on đường Lê Lợi. The shops pound fresh chả mực to take home, and they sell ruốc tôm and mực rim me. Mực một nắng is also sold here, and it is placed at Cô Tô on the provincial list. Ruốc is placed at Quảng Yên, and ruốc tôm is sold at these same markets.

Phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Friday and Saturday, and also on holidays and Tết, on Long Tiên and Lê Quý Đôn. About 50 stalls at the opening, including OCOP, nearly 400 m, 17 tổ, and more than 500 households. The 2023 reports place it in phường Bạch Đằng. From 2025 that ward is inside phường Hồng Gai. After dark on the Bãi Cháy side, phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza sit together. The seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00.

cards.title: Ha Long markets
cards.summary: Fresh squid cake pounded at the shops on Bạch Đằng and Lê Lợi, plus ruốc tôm and mực rim me to carry home.

interestGroups.title: Resort Living
interestGroups.summary: A cabin after the day boats.

cards.title: Resort Living
cards.summary: Overnight on the bay, at the published per-person range. No boat is named on that line.

interestGroups.title: The boat and the towers
interestGroups.summary: The day is a boat among the limestone, and the pair of rocks the port calls the symbol.

cards.title: Fighting Cock Islet
cards.summary: Hòn Trống Mái, seen from the boat. A landing was not described.

interestGroups.title: The two cave routes
interestGroups.summary: The short boat lands in two caves. The long boat lands in Sửng Sốt and rows through Luồn.
body: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Ba Hang is three small notch caves that open onto two salt lakes. You kayak or take a rowboat.
The same boat passes Hòn Chó Đá and Hòn Đỉnh Hương. You look from the deck. It does not stop there. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn together.

cards.title: Sung Sot Cave
cards.summary: On Bồ Hòn. The port calls it the widest yet found, 20 m above the sea.

cards.title: Thien Cung Cave
cards.summary: On đảo Đầu Gỗ. About 3,000 m², 20 m above the sea.

cards.title: Dau Go Cave
cards.summary: The same landing as Thiên Cung. The port calls it one of the earliest known caves.

cards.title: Luon Cave
cards.summary: You row or kayak through the notch into a lake.

interestGroups.title: Ti Top
interestGroups.summary: The only island in the bay that Hồ Chí Minh named, with a crescent of sand and a climb.

cards.title: Ti Top Island
cards.summary: Crescent sand, a swim, a kayak, and a climb. The clock is the 5–6 hour route.

interestGroups.title: Núi Bài Thơ
interestGroups.summary: A 106 m hill over Cửa Lục, with the pagoda and the temple at its foot.

blocks.heading: Chùa Long Tiên
paragraphs: At the foot of the hill. It was built in 1941 under the Nguyễn court, with a three-door gate, and it shares the national ranking of Quyết định 1140-QĐ/BT on 31 August 1992. The festival is when Tết arrives.

blocks.heading: Đền Đức Ông
paragraphs: The temple of Trần Quốc Nghiễn, on the same hill and the same 1992 ranking. Three bays and a rear sanctuary, with Yết Kiêu and Giã Tượng in the side bays. The courtyard is given as 2,531.8 m² and as 2,689.8 m².

cards.title: Poem Mountain
cards.summary: The hill, the flag, and the bay. Ranked a national relic on 31 August 1992.

interestGroups.title: The museum
interestGroups.summary: The coal-block building on Trần Quốc Nghiễn, facing Cửa Lục.

cards.title: Quang Ninh Museum
cards.summary: More than 30,000 objects, in the coal-block building facing Cửa Lục.

interestGroups.title: The cable car over Cửa Lục
interestGroups.summary: The Queen cable car from Bãi Cháy to Ba Đèo, and the bridge you see from the cabin.

cards.title: Queen Cable Car
cards.summary: Ga Đại Dương to Ga Mặt Trời. The length is given as 2.2 km and as 2.222 km.

cards.title: Bai Chay Bridge
cards.summary: Quốc lộ 18 between the shores, the span you see from the cabin.

faqs.a: Route 1 is 3–4 hours for Thiên Cung, Đầu Gỗ, and Ba Hang. Route 2 is 5–6 hours for Ti Tốp, Sửng Sốt, and Luồn. Those clocks are the whole route.

faqs.q: What does the bay ticket cost?
faqs.a: Route 1 is 440,000–460,000 đồng and route 2 is 490,000–510,000 đồng, with a port fee of 40,000–60,000 đồng inside the notice. A 2023 board notice uses a child band of 7 to under 16, and the port sentence uses 7 to 15. From 10 December 2025 you need an identity card or a passport. Do not pay one blended price.

faqs.q: How do I get there from Hanoi?
faqs.a: The road is the usual way. About 2.5 hours is Hanoi to Van Don, not the Bãi Cháy piers. A railway page for Kép–Hạ Long exists, with no departure listed.
Bún bề bề and bún cù kỳ are the morning bowls, at the markets and at Bãi Cháy. Bún hải sản and cháo trai are morning too. Phở is the common breakfast in the center and at Bãi Cháy.

season.label: Clear mornings
season.note: June–September brings fog and heavy rain at Van Don, so confirm the flight and confirm the boat the day you sail. Carnaval has used the late-April and 1 May holiday. In 2026 the night was 18:30–22:30 on 30 April along Trần Quốc Nghiễn.
